breakdown.description: For curved flow, pressure is higher on the outside of the turn to provide the required centripetal force; stating pressure increases toward the center reverses the correct direction of the pressure gradient.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly repeats the incorrect statement 'Apply the condition that pressure increases toward the center of curvature,' which is the same error present in the incomplete prompt. The ground truth correctly indicates that pressure increases outward (away from the center of curvature) via dP/dn = ρV²/R with n directed outward. The agent failed to correct this reversed pressure gradient direction.
